property_summary: For any caller and amounts, the reference contract never reverts when Collect is called with insufficient balance/unlocked time (it simply does nothing and returns), whereas the mutant uses require and thus will revert for inputs that don't meet the preconditions (e.g., insufficient balance or locked), so a call that succeeds (non-reverting) on the reference can revert on the mutant for some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: Change the conditional to require, causing an immediate revert when preconditions fail instead of silently doing nothing.
